title: A Debt for the Deadline
author: Marguerite Nakamura
blurb: Marguerite Underhill, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
